value.rationale: A natural complete count of all shattered sets of every cardinality in an infinite graph family, exposing a strong hierarchy: every pair is shattered from n=5, but the shares of triples and quartets vanish as 12/n and 48/n^2. Exact support structure and thresholds are mathematically motivated refinements of VC dimension, not arbitrary finite examples.
